Where were you when I put the earth on its base? Say

我必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。

While you are living
all will give way before you: as I was with Moses
so I will be with you; I will not take away my help from you or give you up.

and in favor with God and men.

All the multitude sought to touch him
for power came out of him and healed them all.
And all the people were desiring to be touched by him
for power came from him and made them all well.

fear him.

For this reason I say to you
Take no thought for your life

how it may be clothed.

then
